title: Book One · Chapter 171: Pictures in Their Covers
story:
On Friday afternoon, Mei comes back to school. Her mother is with her. Ronan waited at home for Mum. Now he has come back with the permission papers. Miss Wu wants to keep them with the display things overnight.

Mei carries her drawings herself. Her mother holds the bottom board. Now her mother holds some of the weight too. The three window pictures are inside the cover. Clean sheets of paper keep the drawings apart.

They open the cover on a desk. Ronan waits beside the desk. He does not reach for the pictures. Then Mei asks him to hold one corner. He looks at the curtain picture again. The uneven lines still show the air moving. Mei explained the lines to him. Now he likes looking at the picture even more.

Miss Wu checks the names and counts the sheets. She writes the cover's place on her list. The two children with the food-shop drawing arrive with an adult. Their board is larger, but it fits against the dry inner wall. Adults will move it to the display table tomorrow.

Nothing is fixed to the display-room walls yet. The class cupboard holds the smaller pictures and papers. The large board has a safe place in the classroom. Miss Wu keeps the keys.

Leo comes last, a little out of breath. He found the extra game sign at home. He has brought it now. Nobody needs to remember it in the morning.

“I thought I forgot it,” he says.

“You remembered before you came,” Ronan tells him.

“That is a very kind way to say it.”

Someone opened the envelope again. So they count the cards once more. Twelve. The blank-answer pad will come with Mr Qiu tomorrow. Leo points inside the supply box. There is an empty place for the pad. There is also space for Mr Qiu's empty pencil box.

Miss Wu reads the Saturday plan aloud. Mum and Leo's mother bring the stool at half past one. Mr Qiu will bring his loans himself. He plans to come early in the afternoon. The children will meet Miss Wu before opening time. They will finish the labels and put things in place. Visitors enter at two and leave by four. Then the room must be put back.

“Your families may have plans for the evening,” she says. “So we must plan time for clearing too. We must tell everyone our finishing time.”

Ronan has his own small copy. He writes the last line on that. He has no new job to give Dad. Mum and Leo's mother will carry the stool. Dad can leave his tools at work. He can come straight from work if he can.

Mei opens her cover once more. They are still getting ready to leave. She takes out the curtain picture. She sees a small spot near the edge. It is part of the paper, not dirt. She decides to leave it. She does not want to change the drawing tonight. She puts it back with the other two.

Ronan looks at his cat through its cover. One ear is a little larger than the other. He leaves that too.

Miss Wu locks the cupboard. They walk out together. The hall is quiet. Leo tries a soft voice to welcome visitors. He sounds like Mr Qiu. Mei laughs at the sound. Then she tells him to use his own voice tomorrow.

Outside, the evening air is warm. Their work is inside, covered and counted. They say good night at the gate. Ronan walks home with Mum. Leo and Mei go with their own families. Tomorrow they can think about the visitors. Tonight they can go home for dinner.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：supply box＝用品箱；counted＝数目已核对的；clearing＝撤场收拾。

情节提示：loans＝借出的物品；spot＝小斑点；inner wall＝靠里的一面墙。

理解：1. 周五有哪些东西已入校，哪些要周六再来？2. 为什么 Dad 没有被分配搬运任务？
